sentences.text:
Mahadev @ Vishal Deepak Naik vs The State Of Maharashtra on
16 August, 2023
Bench: S. Ravindra Bhat, Aravind Kumar

Item No.6 Court No.5 Section Ii-A
 S U P R E M E C O U R T O F I N D I A
 Record Of Proceedings
 Petition for Special Leave to Appeal (Crl.) No. 6794/2023

(Arising out of impugned final judgment and order dated 28-03-2023
 in Aba No. 192/2023 passed by the High Court of Judicature at
 Bombay)
 Mahadev @ Vishal Deepak Naik Petitioner(s)
 Versus
 The State Of Maharashtra & Anr. Respondent(s)

(IA No.71649/2023-EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED  JUDGMENT and IA No.71650/2023-EXEMPTION FROM FILING O.T. and IA  No.71644/2023-PERMISSION TO FILE SLP WITHOUT CERTIFIED/PLAIN COPY  OF IMPUGNED ORDER)
 Date : 16-08-2023
This matter was called on for hearing today.
HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S. RAVINDRA BHAT  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ARAVIND KUMAR

For Petitioner(s) Mr. Abhay Anil Anturkar, Adv.
 Mr. Dhruv Tank, Adv.
 Mr. Aniruddha Awalgaonkar, Adv.
 Ms. Surbhi Kapoor, AOR

For Respondent(s) Mr. Shivam Dube, Adv.
 Mr. Kunal Cheema, AOR  Mr. Omkar Deshpande, Adv.
 Mr. Siddharth Dharmadhikari, Adv.
 Mr. Aaditya Aniruddha Pande, AOR  Mr. Bharat Bagla, Adv.
 Mr. Sourav Singh, Adv.
 Mr. Aditya Krishna, Adv.
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Mahadev @ Vishal Deepak Naik vs The State Of Maharashtra on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139098892/
1
Permission to file special leave petition without certified/plain copy of impugned order is granted.
After notice was issued, the parties appear to have resolved their disputes amicably.
They have applied jointly SLP (Crl.) No. 6794/2023 1 of 2 for quashing of criminal proceedings.
The application is supported by the affidavits of both parties.
In these circumstances, the Court is satisfied that the parties have agreed of their violation that the criminal proceedings should be put to an end close too.

According, FIR No. 301 of 2022 dated 17.12.2022 lodged by the respondent No.
2 before Kothrud Police Station, Pune under Sections 498A, 377, 323, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 along with all further proceedings arising therefrom are hereby quashed against all accused.
The special leave petition is disposed of in the above terms.
All pending applications are disposed of.

(NEETA SAPRA) (BEENA JOLLY)
COURT MASTER (SH) COURT MASTER (NSH)
